info.name: Help PR - All API routes
info.description: Postman Collection v2.1. Regenerate: node postman/generate-all-routes-collection.js. Import postman/Help-PR-All-Routes.postman_collection.json, then import postman/Local.postman_environment.json (or Staging) and select that environment. Collection Variables hold defaults; Environment overrides base_url, auth_token, and resource ids. Requests use {{base_url}}, {{auth_token}}, {{id}}.

variable.description: API root with protocol, no trailing slash (e.g. http://localhost:5001).
JWT / bearer token from /api/auth/userLogin or /api/auth/login. Prefer storing only in an Environment as type secret.
Generic MongoDB resource _id used in URLs like .../get/{{id}}, .../update/{{id}}.
State document _id (for request bodies linking to state).
Admin user _id (audit / created_by fields if applicable).

item.name: Create user
item.description: Supports multipart form-data. Optional file key: image. Web (is_from_web: true, types 2-4): address, state_id, city_id optional; created_by_id required. For Admin/Employee (types 1 and 3), franchise_id is required. Non-web: state_id and city_id required; password rules apply.

item.name: Get all (paginated)
item.description:
Paginated user list (auth).
Pagination: page, limit.
Filter: type (1=Admin, 2=Partner, 3=Employee, 4=Customer, 5=Super Admin, 6=Staff), is_active.
Search (name, email, phone_number): use keyword or search — same behavior, case-insensitive.
Sort: sort_by or sortBy = name | email | created_at; sort_order or sortOrder = asc | desc.
If sort_by is omitted: only created_at is used; legacy sort = 1 (oldest first) or -1 (newest first, default).
Omit unused query params. Example sort by email descending: sort_by=email&sort_order=desc

item.name: Update
item.description: Supports multipart form-data. Optional file key: image. For Admin/Employee (types 1 and 3), franchise_id is required (either already set on user or provided here).
